subject: Pilot demo — shifting to post-budget approval (FY28 planning)
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya@brightleafhealth.com>

Cc: John Ellis <john.ellis@brightleafhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — shifting to post-budget approval (FY28 planning)

Connor — thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We were hoping to lock the pilot demo for next Tuesday, but John (our VP of Finance) just flagged that the FY28 budget will not be approved until next Thursday.

Between that and our Chief Medical Officer being on an out-of-country trip the following week, we're worried we won't have the right audience in the room to make a decision.

Would you be open to moving the demo to the week after the budget sign-off so we can have finance + CMO present? We still want the pilot — just need to align timing.

Attachments: BrightLeaf_budget_calendar_Q2_3.pdf (referenced)

Thanks,
Maya
Director, Strategy
BrightLeaf Health
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Cc: John Ellis <john.ellis@brightleafhealth.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — shifting to post-budget approval (FY28 planning)

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up and appreciate the context. Totally makes sense to have Finance + the CMO in the room for the pilot decision.

Couple quick options so we don't lose momentum:
- Option A: Move the public demo to Mon, Apr 12 (week after your sign-off) with a 45-min working session and BAU Q&A.
- Option B: Keep the original slot as a technical deep-dive just for product/engineering and record it for C-suite review; then schedule a short decision session after the budget approvals.

I can also loop in our customer success manager and Lauren from commercial to prep a tailored mutual action plan that maps to your budget cycle. If you want, we can tentatively hold Apr 12 at 11am PT and I’ll mark it as tentative on both ends.

I’ll also attach a draft SOW and the mutual action plan template so you can share with Finance ahead of time.

Attachments: Pilot_SOW_redwood_template.docx, BrightLeaf_MAP_v1.pdf

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: John Ellis <john.ellis@brightleafhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot demo — shifting to post-budget approval (FY28 planning)

Maya + team — happy to support. A couple notes on our side to make the post-approval meeting as productive as possible:

1) If you can share the budget window (even high level: capex vs opex timing) we’ll tailor a two-slide ROI snapshot for Finance.
2) For the CMO, would it help to include a short clinical-ops focused agenda item (15 mins) to speak directly to data governance and patient-safety checks?
3) If BrightLeaf needs longer legal review because this is a pilot tied to PHI, we can provide redacted SOC2 evidence and a proposed DPA in advance.

Connor — I can prep the ROI slides and the clinical-ops talking points. I suggest we tentatively hold Apr 12 at 11am PT as Connor suggested, and move to final after you confirm the exact sign-off date.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference

That means Apr 12 should work, but I'd prefer we plan for Apr 13 or 14 to give us a day buffer after the approval to circulate internal paperwork.

Also, from a procurement standpoint, if there are any pricing anchors (term discounts for pilots) please flag them now so we can evaluate during the approval meeting.

-John

Confirmed next steps:
- Hold tentative demo on Wed, Apr 14 at 10am PT (45 minutes) — I’ll send an updated calendar invite and a short agenda.
- Lauren will deliver a 2-slide ROI summary for Finance; Evelyn will provide a one-page summary of compliance artifacts and pilot-level DPA language.
- I’m attaching the SOW template and a pricing note: we can offer a 30% pilot discount (one-time, non-recurring) if BrightLeaf signs the pilot SOW within 14 days of approval. We’ll mark that as a conditional credit in the SOW.

Attachments: Pilot_SOW_redwood_template.docx, BrightLeaf_MAP_v1.pdf
